From: Laura M Soito <lms...@ucdavis.edu>

Crediting Software for Science: Scholarship beyond the research article

Software is a fundamental if not ubiquitous tool in today’s research environment.  Investigators spend hours using and developing software, yet, beyond the research paper, software itself has not been fully recognized as a research product. 

 

What do you do to promote software citation in your scientific community? 

 

We invite you to come together with other investigators on campus spanning the rich diversity of campus research in addressing this question. The goal of this brown box lunch is to create a campus community of and start a conversation amongst research software developers to share practices and needs in the area of software citation.  The luncheon will open with a lightening round of introductions from all participants which we hope will invigorate both large and small group discussion over an informal lunch.

 

Crediting Software for Science: Scholarship beyond the research article

Date:     Monday, June 1

Time:  11:30am - 1:30pm

Place: Library Instruction Room (LIR), 205

                http://www.lib.ucdavis.edu/dept/instruc/about/maps.php?map=lir

 

RSVP to: eve...@geodynamics.org .  Lunch is provided. Please include dietary restrictions.

 

This event is sponsored by Innovating Communication in Scholarship project (ICIS), the Data Science Institute (DSI), and the Computational Infrastructure for Geodynamics (CIG)
